reviewed_finding: Two normalized real pure-state densities have the same diagonal after reversing one amplitude, while the admitted plus effect distinguishes their coherences. Dephasing keeps that diagonal and generally lowers purity. The bit shadow therefore fails to specify these declared qubit states; it neither derives a qubit carrier nor proves completeness of the Q1-Q4 price list.
